title: # ComfyUI Manager
key_points: # ComfyUI Manager **ComfyUI-Manager** is an extension designed to enhance the usability of [ComfyUI](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI).
It offers management functions to **install, remove, disable, and enable** various custom nodes of ComfyUI.
Furthermore, this extension provides a hub feature and convenience functions to access a wide range of information within ComfyUI.
